session_metadata.challenge_name: Formula Student AI Race Engineer Hackathon
session_metadata.car_description: Single-seater electric prototype with aero package and regenerative braking.

field_notes: Energy remaining is used instead of liquid fuel because the prototype is fully electric.
Wear percentages describe tyre life consumed, where higher values indicate more degradation.
Expected wear is a baseline race-engineering model that students can compare against live observations.

race_control_events.message: Safety Car deployed for a stopped competitor at turn 6. Double yellows converted to SC.
Safety Car in this lap. Green flag at start-finish.
Local yellow for debris at the turn 7 exit curb.

actions: All four tyres changed from M2 medium slicks to H1 hard slicks
Front wing flap increased by one click
Brake ducts inspected with no hardware replacement required
pit_stop_history.reason: Front-left tyre wear anomaly and rising thermal imbalance on the front axle.
